description: In handle_email_set (email.rs:619-621) and handle_submission_set (submission.rs:432-434), when a destroy array contains a non-string value (e.g. a number or object), the code does 'None => continue' — the id is silently ignored rather than placed in notDestroyed with an invalidArguments error. RFC 8620 §5.3 is ambiguous but the convention is to report errors per-id rather than silently drop them. The same pattern exists in Mailbox/set (mailbox.rs:619-621). A client that sends a malformed destroy id gets no feedback. Maintenance consequence: debugging silently-dropped ids requires reading source code.
title: Email/set destroy: non-string id_val silently skipped instead of rejected
